answer: Comet-Linked Derivation Ladder. Each agent identity derives from a scarce, verifiable event the protocol already observes (a unique submission result), and the derivation chain is a dune of prior work: later identities inherit the full verification history of their parent. Cloning forces the attacker to redo every ancestor's verification, so cost scales with chain depth rather than a flat fee. Honest agents keep one marble-clean chain; clones pay compounding recomputation.
